author: pro_grammar
scope: Reference data. Raw encyclopedia IDs are PS1 IDs. Spell ID 0 means none. Spawn likelihood values are raw weights. This asset does not alter Tower behavior.

pages.title: Azure Dreams PS1 guide - Bugs
sections: Bugs that cause the game to encounter an exception from which it can't recover, or enter an infinite loop.
Bugs where game logic is waiting for some action to occur but it never does.
Softlocks that are resolved automatically after 30 seconds.
Bugs where the developers clearly intended one thing to happen but something else happens instead (not purely cosmetic).
Cosmetic issues that have no effect on gameplay.
Places where I suspect something might be intended to work differently, but might have been deliberately made otherwise.

floorEvents.1: First visit uses a fixed tutorial layout, placements, and encounters. Later visits choose among four fixed layouts and randomize placements.
floorEvents.2: The enemy table applies to the first ascent according to the guide. Later visits use a fixed layout with no items. The Unity project retains its requested NPC-only override.
floorEvents.12: Blue Collar can appear if still uncollected. An item room can prevent it.
floorEvents.15: Guru oil pot requires the windmill conversation with Isaac and an uncollected pot.
floorEvents.20: Blue Cape requires talking with Okami at the bar and an uncollected cape.
floorEvents.25: The Water Medal quest can spawn a white Picket after talking with Watta.
floorEvents.28: Healing Herb can appear after advancing Cherrl’s story if still uncollected.
floorEvents.31: The first visit can show a Beldo vision. Trap rooms or monster dens can override it.
floorEvents.40: First visit has Beldo. Later visits have Wind Crystals for returning.

towerControls.vsyncCondition: After clearing the game and seeing the message upon leaving Koh’s house.

damage.status: Section headings only. No damage formulas published on this page.

stats.experienceNotes: Experience is doubled for a lower-level recipient. Koh and his familiars share experience from their kills.

examples: Egg-bomb or second tower encounters above monster level 99 can hang.
Gaining 32767 to 39480 EXP at once can crash.
An item room can overwrite a quest item. Trap placement can overwrite the Beldo vision.
Barong’s replacement item rarity check compares the input to itself.
The tile under Koh can retain an occupancy flag if a carried familiar is removed.
